caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um estimated: reported range 150–400 µm; mid value (rsE §b)

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: thin amate; no mechanical data found, needs measurement (rsE §b)

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: 1–3 GPa isotropic, heterogeneous; no mechanical data found (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: reported range 150–400 µm; mid value (rsE §b)

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: laid in a grid and beaten, near-isotropic (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: reported range 150–400 µm; mid value (rsE §b)

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: near-isotropic beaten bark; no data, generic value [E]

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: 1–3 GPa isotropic, heterogeneous; no mechanical data found (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: near-isotropic beaten bark; no data, generic value [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: reported range 150–400 µm; mid value (rsE §b)

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: laid in a grid and beaten, near-isotropic (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: near-isotropic beaten bark; no data, generic value [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: reported range 150–400 µm; mid value (rsE §b)

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: L* ≈ 200·t measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014); paper unmeasured

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: rest opening 27–43° after creasing (Lechenault 2014)

crease_set_rate.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.crease_set_rate)

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
